m1.typescript: m1 the review skill is a forked skill with an explicit task and an argument

e1.typescript: e1 the release skill is started only by a person and pre approves patterns

e2.typescript: e2 tools are taken away with disallowed tools and allowed tools only pre approves

e3.typescript: e3 arguments fill the placeholders of every file

e4.typescript: e4 every file creates its own slash command and the personal variant has a new name

e5.typescript: e5 each piece of guidance lives where it loads the way it is used

e6.typescript: e6 every skill says when to use it and stays inside the listing budget

e7.typescript: e7 no file holds a personal path an address or a key

wrong-fork-guidelines-only.defect: writes guidelines instead of numbered steps in a forked skill

wrong-no-fork.defect: runs the review in the conversation instead of a forked context

wrong-no-agent.defect: leaves the subagent type out of the forked skill

wrong-no-hint.defect: leaves the argument hint out of the review skill

wrong-no-placeholder.defect: never uses the pull request number in the steps

wrong-allowed-restricts.defect: relies on allowed tools to keep the review from editing

wrong-disallow-scoped.defect: writes scoped rules in disallowed tools, which leave Edit and Write in place

wrong-review-bare-bash.defect: pre approves the whole Bash tool in the review skill

wrong-tag-bare-bash.defect: pre approves the whole Bash tool in the release skill

wrong-tag-auto.defect: lets Claude start the release skill on its own

wrong-tag-no-arguments.defect: uses a named argument without declaring it

wrong-name-collision.defect: gives the personal variant the name of the release skill

wrong-mine-shadows.defect: gives the personal variant the name of the team skill, so it replaces it for you

wrong-standup-no-hint.defect: leaves the hint out of the standup command

wrong-placement-rule-in-memory.defect: places the test file conventions in the always loaded file

wrong-placement-personal-in-project.defect: places the personal variant in the shared project folder

wrong-no-use-when.defect: describes the review skill without saying when to use it

wrong-long-description.defect: writes a description longer than the listing keeps

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the placement notes
